title: "The Bourbon Boat" Kentucky River Tours
specs: Cruise past historic sites including Daniel Boone's grave, Frank's Ford, Leestown Settlement
View operational Lock and Dam #4 and Buffalo Trace Distillery on some tours
Wildlife sightings include Blue Heron, Bald Eagles, river otters, and white-tailed deer
No outside alcohol allowed on board either boat
USCG Type I lifejackets available for all passengers
Captains hold USCG Master's Licenses and other certifications
Private charters available for groups up to 45 on The Bourbon Belle and 15 on The Trace of Kentucky
School field trips accommodated with group options for up to 15 or 49 passengers

blurb: Guests board comfortable boats in downtown Frankfort to cruise the Kentucky River, viewing historic sites, distilleries, and wildlife. Tours include narration about local history, bourbon industry, and nature. Options include private charters, school field trips, and paddle tours with distillery visits.
